test.create_query: CREATE TABLE threshold_top_k_hot ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY () AS SELECT /* 1000 heavy groups carry 30% of the rows (~12000 rows each); the rest spreads over ~10M rare groups */ if(number % 10 < 3, intHash64(number % 1000), intHash64(1000 + rand64() % 10000000)) AS k, number AS v, number % 1000000 AS u FROM numbers_mt(40000000)

CREATE TABLE threshold_top_k_flat ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY () AS SELECT /* a weak skew: the hottest group gets only tens of rows, so per-thread partial values say almost nothing about the merged order */ intHash64(rand64() % (1 + rand64() % 10000000)) AS k, number AS v FROM numbers_mt(40000000)
